label: Besöksräknare — egen statistiksida
summary: First-party visitor counter the site OWNER can actually see: an invisible <VisitBeacon /> in the root layout posts one hit per navigation to /api/visits, the server counts page views and visits per local day in Upstash Redis (plain REST, no SDK), and a standardized /statistik page renders today's numbers, totals and a 14-day bar chart via <VisitorStats />. Cookieless, no personal data. Demo mode (mock: seed): without a real store the counter ticks an in-memory sample series and the page shows an honest demo notice — never a crash, never a fake 'real' number.
summarySv: En egen besöksräknare med en färdig statistiksida på /statistik: hur många som besökt sajten idag, totalt och per dag de senaste två veckorna. Räknar utan cookies och sparar inget om enskilda besökare. Tills statistiklagringen är kopplad visas exempelsiffror i demoläge med en tydlig notis; därefter räknas riktiga besök.

envVars.purpose: REST endpoint of the Upstash Redis database that stores the counters (https://…upstash.io). Created under the project's Storage tab (Upstash Redis) or at console.upstash.com; the code also accepts the Marketplace alias KV_REST_API_URL. Tagged feature-runtime: a missing or placeholder value keeps the counter in in-memory demo mode instead of crashing.

REST token for the same Upstash Redis database (server-only, never sent to the browser). Marketplace alias KV_REST_API_TOKEN is accepted too. Tagged feature-runtime: missing or placeholder → demo mode with a notice on /statistik.

notes: New 2026-09-02 (owner decision): sites deploy into Sajtmaskin's Vercel team, so Vercel Analytics is invisible to the site owner — this dossier is the owner-visible default for `analytics`; vercel-analytics stays as the explicit sibling. Demo store + env gate + route contract are unit-tested; a live INCR against a real Upstash database in a deployed preview is still required before verificationStatus becomes accepted.
